description.la: Vita Felicis confessoris Nolani, a Beda ex hexametris Paulini Nolani in prosam sermonem redacta.
description.en-US: Bede's prose retelling of Paulinus of Nola's hexameter poems on St. Felix of Nola (3rd century): the priest who survived persecution, hidden by a spider's web and fed by an angel. Latin text of Migne (PL 94); English translation of J. A. Giles (1843).
description.pt-BR: O resumo em prosa que Beda fez dos poemas em hexâmetros de Paulino de Nola sobre São Félix de Nola (séc. III): o sacerdote que sobreviveu à perseguição, escondido por uma teia de aranha e alimentado por um anjo.

sources.edition: Vita Felicis confessoris (Beda) on Latin Wikisource, from the Corpus Corporum TEI of Migne PL 94.
sources.description: Wikitext removed; PL column numbers dropped; one chapter.
sources.tierEvidence: Eighth-century text in Migne's reprint: public domain.

sources.edition: The Miscellaneous Works of Venerable Bede, ed. and trans. J. A. Giles, vol. 4 (London: Whittaker, 1843), in the reprint as 'The Minor Historical Works of Venerable Bede'; archive.org theminorhistoric00bede.
sources.tierEvidence: Giles died in 1884; printed 1843: public domain.
